newsitem.title: UK: Sullom Voe Brent loadings still halted due winds.
newsitem.headline: Sullom Voe Brent loadings still halted due winds.

text.p: Loading at the Brent Blend terminal at Sullom Voe on the Shetland Islands remained suspended for a second day on Thursday but was expected to resume in the afternoon, a port official said.
He said two tankers were waiting alongside but not loading because of force 8-9 westerly winds which have been gusting since Wednesday morning.
"Loading is expected to commence this afternoon," he said.
